game.romname: Score International Baja 1000 - World Championship Off Road Racing (USA, Europe)
game.name: SCORE International Baja 1000 World Championship O (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Baja 1000 on Xbox 360 is an off-road racing game that offers motorbikes, quads, buggies and other 4x4s in wild environments. The tracks are made up of different routes and their profile allows you to use a turbo as often as possible, in order to beat an addictive AI. The game features two multiplayer modes. One is a two player split screen mode and the other is an online mode where 8 users can compete simultaneously.
